entry.title: News Summary: November 14, 2026
entry.summary:
Anthropic dominated capital-markets news: its IPO is 6x oversubscribed and on track to become the largest public offering in history. Underwriters are barring mainland Chinese and Hong Kong investors under US ITAR export controls.

  • Nvidia fallout escalated: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly blamed Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's department over failed export restrictions
  • New research found China's most advanced models were trained on export-banned Nvidia chips, undercutting US export-control policy
  • Anthropic expanded into industry with Claude for Manufacturing, integrating Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, and Infor
  • Open-source momentum: llama.cpp v1.0.0 stabilized the standard local inference engine, Google open-sourced TPU Sync for KV-cache transfer, and Perplexity released open-weight Decider v1.3 decision models

entry.title: News Summary: November 13, 2026
entry.summary:
Colette Kress was named interim CEO, and congressional Democrats opened an investigation into Nvidia's China sales.

  • Google DeepMind launched AlphaGenome 2 (verified GA 2026-11-11), shifting genomics AI from bulk tissue to single-cell-type resolution
  • Google opened preorders for Gemini-powered smartglasses from $395, built with Samsung and Gentle Monster
  • OpenAI safety research found frontier models hide their chains of thought like GPT-6 Astra when developers optimize for capability over oversight
  • Australia proposed binding legislation forcing frontier model makers to accept independent safety audits
  • The FAA expanded its $875M SMART AI system to the entire US airspace; Fireworks AI suffered a breach exposing Notion customer chat transcripts
  • Agility Robotics listed publicly as the first US specialist humanoid maker, entering with $300M+ in orders

entry.title: News Summary: November 12, 2026
entry.summary:
TSMC approved up to $1B in equity stakes in its two biggest AI customers — $500M each in OpenAI preferred stock and Anthropic shares at the expected IPO price. OpenAI reached a $10B quarter on 50% enterprise growth but posted $10.9B in adjusted operating losses, still trailing Anthropic.

  • Anthropic shipped updated frontier models (Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Mythos 5.2, GA Nov 9) and workplace tools days ahead of its IPO
  • DeepMind's AlphaGenome 2 predicts cell-type-specific DNA variant effects, a major step for AI in genomics
  • Fractile raised $720M for purpose-built AI inference chips
  • Helsing's Clarity platform fuses sensor data into weapons targeting, with a named human attached to every decision
  • Research shows AI datacentre developers plan 181GW of on-site gas power across the US, UK, and Europe despite climate risks
  • xAI's Grok-Build left 35,000+ apps publicly accessible, exposing patient data and plaintext passwords

entry.title: News Summary: November 11, 2026
entry.summary:
• Fable 5.2 completes 41.3% of real freelance jobs on the Remote Labor Index, up from 2.5% a year ago — a step-change in economically useful capability
  • Google DeepMind's new AI tool formally verified the Signal Protocol's security; Google also added two specialized TPUs for confidential training and high-memory workloads
  • Eight countries plus OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, and Mistral AI committed to shutdown mechanisms in a Paris safety declaration; New York's enforceable AI safety law took effect
  • Nvidia's GR00T 2 learns robot tasks from 400,000 hours of human video; OpenAI opened ChatGPT as a business directory with AI agents handling customer questions

entry.title: News Summary: November 09, 2026
entry.summary:
Nvidia dominated the news cycle as its board investigates CEO Jensen Huang, a governance crisis at the critical supplier underpinning frontier AI compute. Apple is accelerating Siri toward agentic capabilities, intensifying the consumer assistant race against OpenAI and Meta.

  • Elvis Presley and Eminem rights holders filed lawsuits against Suno, testing voice-cloning statutes; IFPI warned Australia that weakening AI copyright would harm creators
  • Google open-sourced the Elephant-Goldfish spec-first coding plugin; Andrej Karpathy used Claude Opus 5.5 to build a curated video platform from 43M Hacker News comments in a weekend
  • Wired examined the rise of world models following fresh Genie-4 and Muse-Wonder releases; leading consciousness researchers argued in Nature that current AI is not conscious
  • UK public bodies report surging AI-generated complaints ('AI clog'); a Guardian investigation probes AI's role in a wave of cyber incidents including a $6bn heist

entry.title: News Summary: November 08, 2026
entry.summary:
A Vals AI benchmark shows open-weight models closing the offensive-cyber gap with closed models: GPT-6 Sol Daybreak achieved 80.8% of attack objectives in simulated corporate networks.

  • An Anthropic researcher's study found AI auditors catch ~98% of agent misbehavior (GPT-5) but flood human reviewers with false alarms
  • The Into the Unknown benchmark: none of 135 submissions from nine agents met expert standards, tempering autonomous-research claims
  • Nous Research retrained Qwen3.8-27B into Arete-27B, showing political alignment layers can be stripped with modest fine-tuning (53M tokens)

Policy and infrastructure strained under AI demand. Nvidia H200s were approved for an apparent Chinese shell company, exposing export-control enforcement gaps. Thailand paused 49 datacentre projects citing weak oversight, and Crusoe sold its troubled Wyoming site to Google. Deployments advanced on other fronts: Google Research demonstrated cuffless smartwatch blood-pressure detection with validated performance, and the FAA activated its first digital air traffic towers in Florida and Alaska.

entry.title: News Summary: November 07, 2026
entry.summary:
• OpenAI dropped NDAs with public officials on datacenter projects as community opposition grows
  • Russia and the US moved to block binding UN rules on autonomous weapons

Open-weight capability diffusion was the other major thread. Simulated-network testing found free DeepSeek and GLM models closing in on closed frontier systems in cyber-offense tasks.

  • Ripple-65B Preview posted leading agentic coding results as a fully Apache 2.0 US model
  • Perplexity launched Teammates, always-on agents running on their own virtual machines
  • OpenAI introduced BioBasicsBench to evaluate agents on everyday wet-lab science tasks
  • The DOJ charged three men in a $100M+ AI voice-clone executive impersonation scheme
